script.description: Self-contained workflow script (plain JavaScript, not TypeScript) starting with `export const meta = {...}`.

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. To iterate on a workflow, edit the file and re-invoke with the same scriptPath instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script`.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string.

budgetUsd.description: Hard USD spending ceiling for the run; agent() throws once exceeded. Omit for no ceiling.

resumeFromExecutionId.description: Execution ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run.

allowedTools.description: Default tool allowlist for subagents (per-call opts.allowedTools overrides). Defaults to read-only: Read, Grep, Glob. Widen deliberately for workflows that must write.
